exhibits.title: Spot Price
exhibits.statement: Bitcoin (BTC) traded at $75,972.00 as of 2026-11-07 06:49:55 UTC, +0.16% over one hour and +0.42% over twenty-four hours.

exhibits.title: 24-Hour Trading Range
exhibits.statement: Over twenty-four hours the price ranged from $74,921.00 to $76,266.00; spot sits at 78% of that range.

exhibits.title: Seven-Day Trend
exhibits.statement: Price is -1.50% over seven days. The 24-hour average ($75,822.50) is below the 72-hour average ($77,637.05). Spot is 5.82% below the seven-day high of $80,668.65 and 1.40% above the seven-day low of $74,921.00.

exhibits.statement: Realized volatility computed from hourly closes is 1.96% per day. The 14-hour relative strength index reads 59.4, conventionally neutral.

exhibits.statement: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index reads 25 ("Extreme Fear"), versus 30 7 days earlier.

exhibits.title: Chainlink Price Feed
exhibits.statement: The Chainlink BTC/USD Data Feed on Ethereum mainnet last reported $75,933.68, 44 minutes before the spot quote and -0.05% against the spot price in Exhibit A. Practice positions are entered and settled at this mark.

arguments.text:
May it please the Court.  

1. The spot price is firmly anchored near the upper‑mid portion of its 24‑hour range, sitting at 78 % of that band (Ex. B), while hourly momentum remains neutral (RSI 59.4, Ex. D); this positioning implies limited downside pressure and a bias toward modest upside as buyers defend the upper range.  

2. Despite a 1.50 % seven‑day decline (Ex. C), the market exhibits ample liquidity—$25.74 billion traded in the last day, representing 1.69 % of market cap (Ex. E)—providing the depth needed for a sustained bullish intraday move without triggering large sell‑offs.  

3. Fear dominates sentiment (Fear & Greed Index 25, Ex. F), a historically contrarian bullish signal, and the Chainlink feed confirms the spot at $75,933.68 (Ex. G), ensuring our practice entry aligns with the most reliable price reference.  

The Bull rests.

May it please the Court.  

1. The spot price is firmly entrenched near the upper‑mid portion of its 24‑hour range, sitting at 78 % of that range, indicating limited upside potential and a high probability of mean‑reversion toward the range midpoint [Ex. B].  

2. Recent market sentiment is deeply fearful, with the Fear & Greed Index at 25, a level that historically precedes short‑covering pull‑backs rather than fresh buying, especially when paired with a seven‑day downtrend of –1.50 % and a 5.82 % gap below the seven‑day high [Ex. C, F].  

3. Liquidity remains ample at $25.74 billion (1.69 % of market cap), and the Chainlink price feed—our settlement benchmark—is only 0.05 % below the spot, ensuring execution precision for a short position without slippage risk [Ex. E, G].  

For these reasons the Bear respectfully requests the Court open a short practice position on BTC/USD.  

The Bear rests.

Your Honor, the Bear’s claim that “78 % of the 24‑hour range caps upside” ignores the fact that the price sits merely 0.42 % above its 24‑hour average, showing negligible pull‑back pressure; the range is narrow (≈$1,345) and a modest rise can reclaim the top without violating any technical barrier [Ex. B].  

Second, the Fear & Greed Index at 25 does not guarantee short‑term weakness; extreme fear historically foreshadows buying rebounds, especially when the RSI is still neutral at 59.4, indicating no oversold condition to sustain a decline [Ex. D, F].  

Thus the Bear’s downside case is unsubstantiated. Nothing further.

Your Honor, the Bull’s first point collapses under the seven‑day weakness: price sits 5.82 % below its recent high (Ex. C), showing buyers cannot even defend the upper‑mid range, and the RSI at 59.4 is merely neutral, not bullish (Ex. D). Second, the “contrarian” fear signal is muted; the Fear & Greed Index is only 25, still far from the historic extreme‑fear threshold of 20 that typically precedes rebounds (Ex. F), so it does not guarantee upside. Moreover, the Chainlink feed is 0.05 % below spot (Ex. G), indicating a slight downward bias at entry. Nothing further.

ruling.holding: The Court finds a short practice position on BTC/USD is warranted.

findings.finding: Spot price is slightly up 0.42% over 24 h, indicating limited immediate upside
Price sits at 78% of its 24‑hour range, suggesting proximity to the upper band and potential mean‑reversion
Seven‑day decline of –1.5% and price 5.82% below the recent high show sustained bearish pressure
Fear & Greed Index at 25 reflects extreme fear, a contrarian signal that often precedes further declines in the short term
RSI at 59.4 is neutral, offering no bullish momentum to offset bearish bias

ruling.opinion: The evidence shows BTC/USD trading near the top of its daily range (Ex. B) while a seven‑day downtrend persists (Ex. C) and fear is elevated (Ex. F). Neutral RSI (Ex. D) provides no upside catalyst, and the modest 24‑hour gain (Ex. A) is insufficient to overcome mean‑reversion pressure. Accordingly, a short practice position is justified.
ruling.dissent: The Bull could argue that extreme fear (Ex. F) is historically contrarian and that neutral RSI (Ex. D) leaves room for a rebound, but the weight of bearish technical and sentiment indicators outweighs this view.
